verdict.rationale: Alloy documents an Events API for submitting transaction events. Those events can be routed to transaction-monitoring Source Workflows, with results returned in evaluations[], and the docs reference external entity IDs for tying data to customers. However, nothing documents counterparty identifiers on transaction payloads. For recovery, the only relevant evidence is the 206 partial-evaluation warnings about missing data. Webhook retry logic covers outbound delivery, not rejected input, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: documented counterparty identifier fields on transaction events, documented validation-error/rejection responses and resubmission or idempotency guidance for ingest, independent or hands-on corroboration.
